raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

On gfx950, GLM-5.x MXFP4 checkpoints now turn on `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS` when it is unset, because AITER tunes their fused MoE only for the fused shared-expert shape. Related: #28985, #59221, #60604.

## Claims

- GLM-5.2-MXFP4, MI355X, TP4, MTP: output throughput +7-14%, mean TPOT -6-12%, prefill TTFT -6-7%; gsm8k within stderr, MTP acceptance unchanged.
- An explicit 0 or 1 still wins. Other models, platforms and layouts keep the default (off).

## Validation

- `pytest tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py -k "not test_models_fse_init"`: 90 passed, 9 new (the deselected cases need a free GPU). pre-commit clean.
- `create_engine_config()` on real checkpoints: flag on for GLM-5.1/5.2/5.3-MXFP4 at TP4 and GLM-5.2-MXFP4 at TP8; unchanged for TP2, EP, GLM-5.2-FP8, AITER off.
- Serving, GLM-5.2-MXFP4, MI355X, TP4, MTP3, two runs per arm in ABBA order, no failed requests. Flag on is this PR's default:

| workload | output tok/s, flag off → on | mean TPOT (ms), flag off → on |
|---|---|---|
| 1k/1k c16 | 1472.6 → 1671.6 (+13.5%) | 10.09 → 8.89 (-11.9%) |
| 1k/1k c64 | 3095.1 → 3365.6 (+8.7%) | 19.34 → 17.71 (-8.4%) |
| 8k/1k c64 | 1541.9 → 1654.7 (+7.3%) | 35.51 → 33.19 (-6.5%) |

- 8k-in prefill median TTFT: 475.8 → 449.0 ms at c1, 6701.5 → 6240.0 ms at c16.
- This PR's head with the flag unset, one run: 1681.7 tok/s / 8.87 ms at 1k/1k c16, 3503.5 tok/s / 17.32 ms at c64; the server log shows the auto-enable line and every FP4 MoE lookup on the tuned 257 / top-9 rows.
- gsm8k 5-shot strict: 0.9386 flag off, 0.9393 flag on, 0.9333 in both runs of this PR with the flag unset (stderr 0.007). MTP acceptance length 3.31, 3.31, 3.30.

<details>
<summary>Per-run numbers, kernel lookups and reproduction</summary>

Image `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` (AITER 0.1.25) running main at 7f730b4 and this branch from source. The decode rows and gsm8k compare main with the flag set to 0 and 1 (F1-F4). The prefill rows compare main and this branch with the flag unset (P1-P4). P2/P3 ran an earlier revision of this branch with the same enable conditions. R1 is the head (c716073) with the flag unset, one run; its c64 throughput is 4% above the F2/F3 mean, and Claims use F1-F4 only.

| run | arm | 1k/1k c16 tok/s, TPOT | 1k/1k c64 tok/s, TPOT | 8k/1k c64 tok/s, TPOT | 8k/1 c1 / c16 median TTFT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | main, flag 0 | 1463.5, 10.07 | 3105.2, 19.57 | 1515.4, 35.77 | |
| F2 | main, flag 1 | 1691.1, 8.80 | 3383.7, 17.73 | 1646.9, 33.42 | |
| F3 | main, flag 1 | 1652.0, 8.98 | 3347.4, 17.68 | 1662.5, 32.96 | |
| F4 | main, flag 0 | 1481.6, 10.11 | 3084.9, 19.10 | 1568.3, 35.24 | |
| P1 | main, unset | | | | 475.2 / 6703.7 |
| P2 | branch, unset | 1632.5, 9.04 | 3359.5, 17.37 | 1654.9, 32.93 | 450.8 / 6247.8 |
| P3 | branch, unset | | | | 447.2 / 6232.1 |
| P4 | main, unset | | | | 476.4 / 6699.2 |
| R1 | branch head, unset | 1681.7, 8.87 | 3503.5, 17.32 | | |

gsm8k strict / flexible: F1 0.9386 / 0.9371, F2 0.9393 / 0.9378, P2 0.9333 / 0.9333, R1 0.9333 / 0.9340. MTP acceptance length over each gsm8k run: F1 3.31, F2 3.31, P2 3.30, R1 3.30. Decode-run TTFT is within noise (8k/1k c64 median 1022 / 1245 ms flag off, 1274 / 1284 ms flag on; mean 4466 / 4508 vs 4220 / 4323 ms).

AITER fused-MoE lookups in the server log (120 FP4 lookups per run across the 4 ranks):
- flag off (F1, P1): all are `(6144, 512, 256, 8, ..., float4_e2m1fn_x2, per_1x32)` and log "using 2stage default".
- flag on (F2, P2, R1): all are `(6144, 512, 257, 9, ...)` and pick tuned FlyDSL kernels (`flydsl_mxmoe_g1_a4w4_*` or `flydsl_moe1_afp4_wfp4_*`, then `flydsl_moe2_*`). The BF16 MTP layer stays `(256, 8)` in both arms.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MLA=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_RMSNORM=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM=0 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4BMM=0 \
vllm serve amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --tensor-parallel-size 4 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --max-model-len 16384 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'

# C in {16, 64}. 8k/1k c64: --random-input-len 8192 --num-prompts 256 --seed 43.
# Prefill: --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1, 16 prompts at c1, 256 at c16.
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --ignore-eos --temperature 0 \
  --num-prompts $((8 * C)) --max-concurrency $C --seed 42

lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 1 \
  --model_args model=amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False
```

</details>

## Details

- Cause: AITER 0.1.25's `glm5_fp4_tuned_fmoe.csv` tunes this model's gfx950 W4A4 MoE only at 257 experts / top-9 (TP1/2/4/8 per-rank sizes); the unfused 256 / top-8 MoE gets default heuristics.
- Placement: the `GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM` config hook sets the env var, like the `VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH` auto-enable: the MoE router reads the process-wide flag, and the env var is in the torch.compile cache key.
- Gate: TP4/TP8 without DP, PCP or EP, as in #59221. The per-layer quantization check still runs, so the BF16 MTP layer of GLM-5.2/5.3-MXFP4 stays unfused (one existing warning per worker).
- Limits: TP8 and GLM-5/5.1/5.3-MXFP4 (same shapes) checked at config level only. TP2 stays opt-in, unmeasured. MI355X serving is not in CI.

Not a duplicate: #59221/#60604 cover GLM-5.3-Flash, #57916 MXFP8, #58904 weight loading; none changes the `glm_moe_dsa` default.

<details>
<summary>Design notes and duplicate search</summary>

- #28985 turned the flag off globally for mixed-precision shared experts (Kimi INT4 routed + BF16 shared), DeepSeek FP4 precision and EPLB. Here the shared expert is MXFP4 like the routed experts, the per-layer quantization check still applies and EP is excluded; gsm8k is unchanged.
- The gate is per model, like GLM-5.3-Flash's `_fused_shared_experts_tuned` and DeepSeek-V4's, because each follows its own AITER table (GLM-5.3-Flash adds gfx942 in #60604; this model's table is gfx950 only).
- A per-layer default inside the model, leaving the env var unset, would also need `GroupedTopKRouter`, `rocm_aiter_grouped_topk`, `FusedMoEConfig` and `RocmPlatform.apply_config_platform_defaults` to stop reading the global flag.
- The env var stays set for the rest of the process, as with the breakable-cudagraph auto-enable. With `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER` unset (vLLM's default) nothing changes.
- Searched `gh pr list --state all` for "fused shared experts GLM", "VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS default", "GLM-5 MXFP4 ROCm", "GLM-5.2 MXFP4 AITER" and "shared experts fusion ROCm GLM". Also related: #60831 (opt-in GLM-5 MonoKernel decode, which requires this flag on), #53248 (Quark exclude check), #53953 (AITER fusions for GLM-5.2-MXFP4, no FSE change), #61345 (DeepSeek-V4 MegaMoE FSE opt-in).

</details>
